actual_counters.cargo_download_bytes_unknown_reason: Cargo log output does not provide authoritative per-package transferred byte counts.
actual_counters.fresh_compiler_units_unknown_reason: The retained run has no complete compiler-unit receipt; Compiling lines and MBX lookup counters are not unit totals.
actual_counters.link_duration_unknown_reason: No separate linker start/end event is present; Cargo build/test step spans combine compiler and link work.
actual_counters.lock_wait_unknown_reason: Hosted APIs and retained logs contain no separate lock-wait measurement; task report zero sentinels are unavailable telemetry.

mbx_object_cache_summary_totals.scope: sum of actual MBX summary counters only; zero is not compiler freshness or full cache-transfer telemetry

actual_counters.native_cpu_unknown_reason: Local compiler observer receipts lack exact hosted run/job/attempt/source identity and are not joinable to this run.
actual_counters.runner_queue_duration_unknown_reason: The retained workflow-run and jobs APIs expose no queue-start/end pair or dependency-wait split.
actual_counters.tool_download_bytes_unknown_reason: Pinned Mise progress output has human-readable progress, not a stable authoritative byte counter.
actual_counters.tool_download_duration_unknown_reason: Mise log lines contain progress snapshots, not a unique completed transfer interval; enclosing Prepare pinned tools API step span is reported by phase.

jobs.queue_unknown_reason: GitHub jobs response has no queue timestamp; created-to-started can include dependency wait and scheduler/runner startup.

legacy_task_report_telemetry.reason: No extracted task report directory was supplied.

log_coverage.note: Missing step logs leave only the API span; they are not backfilled from aggregate job logs.

measurement_policy.bytes: log-reported cumulative received/uploaded counters only; artifact/cache stored size is never presented as network transfer
measurement_policy.compiler: Cargo Compiling text and MBX not-looked-up/miss counts do not estimate total fresh compiler/link work
measurement_policy.durations: GitHub Actions run/job/step API start and completion timestamps only
measurement_policy.unknowns: null plus reason when an API/log counter cannot isolate a requested phase

byte_channels.cache_transfer_bytes_unknown_reason: Authoritative only in actual_counters.cache_transfer_totals_by_phase; the lifecycle view never re-sums them.
byte_channels.mbx_object_cache_summaries_unknown_reaso: Corroborating observations only in actual_counters.mbx_object_cache_summary_totals; never promoted into compiler or cache-transfer counts.
byte_channels.origin_acquisition_bytes_unknown_reason: Owned observation bindings do not join to origin receipts in this collector; origin bytes stay unknown here.
byte_channels.separation_rule: Origin bytes, cache bytes, and historical MBX summaries are kept separate and never summed together.

observed_lifecycle.dedup_scope: each real job, attempt, and bound task report is counted exactly once; a retained job contributes its original work once and a rerun contributes its new work in addition to earlier work

effective_required.scope: exactly the retained-or-rerun jobs accepted for the current verdict

executed_lifecycle.scope: every supplied authenticated job record counted once; includes bootstrap, helpers, preparation, replay, and failed or cancelled attempts with no role or conclusion filter

join.method: each owned observation resolved through the authenticated effective-job map by actual producer job/attempt; forged or stale attempts fail instead of joining

missing_coverage.unknown_reason: Jobs and task reports without a bound observation stay unknown; they are never counted as zero work.

process_counts.compiler_executions_unknown_reason: Owned bindings carry identity, not per-process compiler events; unobserved process work stays unknown, never zero.
process_counts.native_process_executions_unknown_reason: Absolute native calls and unobserved build-script network access are not covered by owned bindings; they stay unknown, never zero.

phase_map.normalization: case-fold, replace punctuation with spaces, collapse tokens, then exact whole-name lookup

logs_archive.entry_count_method: ZIP count includes all archive entries; candidates are immediate job-folder .txt files, including summary files; joins require exact API job and step archive paths.
logs_archive.label: actions_run_logs_zip

workflow.reason: Both contents API response and exact workflow bytes are required.

timeline.observed_job_span_method: latest job completion minus earliest job start; envelope only, not a DAG critical path
timeline.runner_queue_unknown_reason: The retained workflow-run and jobs APIs expose no queue-start/end pair or dependency-wait split.
